title: Print Numbers from 1 to N
description: Read a positive integer `N` and print all numbers from `1` to `N` separated by spaces on a single line.
instructions: Print the numbers separated by single spaces (no trailing space required, though trimmed).
hints: Collect numbers in a list/array and join with `" "` or print inline.
Python: `print(" ".join(str(i) for i in range(1, n + 1)))`
Java: use `StringBuilder` and `trim()` or print space between elements.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input().strip())
